name: Saint Traft
description: A young priest of the Church of Avacyn on Innistrad, recognized as a saint, who was murdered by Withengar and became a geist.

description_citations.text: "Traft". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Traft hunts demons with Avacyn's angels along the Ashmouth and is recognized as a saint before his fortieth year.
timeline.quote: he became recognized as a saint before his fortieth year

citation.work: The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The demons plot revenge on Traft for frustrating their plans.
timeline.quote: So, as demons do, they laid a trap and plotted their revenge.

citation.work: The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Traft returns home to Shadowgrange and finds an angel on his roof and his wards scratched out.
timeline.quote: The wards above his door had been scratched out and neutralized

citation.work: The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Inside, Traft finds a demonic dagger through a map at Needle's Eye, a bloody message demanding he come without angels, and a girl's finger.
timeline.quote: Resting near the words was the finger of a young girl.

citation.work: The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Traft lies to the angel, telling her it is nothing, to save the child, and rides to Needle's Eye.
timeline.quote: "It's nothing," he told her. "I'll handle it."

citation.work: The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The angel senses the lie but trusts Traft and does not follow.
timeline.quote: She did as he wished, and did not follow.

citation.work: The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Traft fights through bats and a mad vampire, sacrificing his horse, to reach the crest of Needle's Eye.
timeline.quote: But he made his way to the highest point of the pass: the crest of Needle's Eye.

citation.work: The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Cultists with a possessed girl confront Traft; the cult-priest threatens to kill her if he calls angels and shrouds the pass in black fog.
timeline.quote: "You call your angels, and she dies," said the cultist.

citation.work: The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Traft refuses to call the angels or even use a warding spell and fights blind in the fog, killing cultists and the lead cultist.
timeline.quote: Within the dark fog, Traft's blade found cultist after cultist.

citation.work: The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Traft discovers he was tricked into killing with the cult-priest's bone dagger, doing a demon's bidding.
timeline.quote: Tricked into doing a demon's bidding yet again.

citation.work: The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Traft frees the girl from possession and sends her home.
timeline.quote: "Go," he told her. "Run, child. Run home."

citation.work: The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Withengar rises from the crack in the earth and Traft finally calls on the angels.
timeline.quote: As the horns and spreading wings of a great demon rose from the rent in the ground

citation.work: The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Withengar destroys Saint Traft; the angel and her attendants drive Withengar back for a time, but he resumes tormenting the world.
timeline.quote: The demon Withengar had destroyed the living saint, the famed slayer of demonkind.

citation.work: The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Traft never enters the Blessed Sleep and becomes a geist haunting the world.
timeline.quote: he never passed into the Blessed Sleep, and instead became a geist to haunt the world.

citation.work: The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: At the Battle of Thraben, empowered by Traft's geist, Thalia fights Eldrazi; Sigarda rescues her from Brisela and they defeat the fused sisters.
timeline.quote: Together, Thalia and Sigardia bested the fused sisters.

citation.work: Thalia
citation.text: "Thalia", section "Order of Saint Traft". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul's presence forces Saint Traft out of Thalia, nearly driving her mad.
timeline.quote: forced Saint Traft to leave Thalia's body

citation.work: Thalia
citation.text: "Thalia", section "Order of Saint Traft". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The holy geist of Saint Traft appears beside Thalia.
timeline.quote: radiant but insubstantial, a holy geist.

citation.work: The Lunarch Inquisition
citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: With Saint Traft's power, Thalia lifts the spear and mounts it on her saddle as the order's banner.
timeline.quote: We ride under this banner now,

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Thalia meets the geist of Saint Traft in an ancient chapel and takes him in.
timeline.quote: Will you take me in?

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia calls on Saint Traft to summon the spirits of the dead, who possess and shield her soldiers.
timeline.quote: It was Traft who called them, and they answered his summons.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia declines to force possession on those who cannot accept the spirits.
timeline.quote: I can't make that choice for them.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: With Saint Traft's help, Thalia lifts Avacyn's spear and is given glowing angelic wings.
timeline.quote: glowing, translucent wings spread out from her back, the blessing of some unseen angel.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: During the Invasion Rem teams up with Saint Traft to protect the plane.
timeline.quote: Rem teamed up with Saint Traft to protect the plane

citation.work: Rem Karolus
citation.text: "Rem Karolus", section "Fighting the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Traft vanquishes evil creatures, especially demons along the Ashmouth, aided by Avacyn's warrior-seraphs.
timeline.quote: he vanquished all manner of evil creatures

citation.work: Traft
citation.text: "Traft", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Demons lure Traft to Needle's Eye by ransoming a girl; he is tricked into killing cultists and murdered by Withengar.
timeline.quote: then murdered by the demonlord

citation.work: Traft
citation.text: "Traft", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Traft does not enter the Blessed Sleep and becomes a geist.
timeline.quote: he never passed into the Blessed Sleep and instead became a geist to haunt the world

citation.work: Traft
citation.text: "Traft", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thalia leaves the infiltrated church and creates the Order of Saint Traft with Traft's geist.
timeline.quote: created the Order of Saint Traft to battle evil

citation.work: Traft
citation.text: "Traft", section "Eldritch Moon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Battle of Thraben Traft possesses Thalia to protect her and fight the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: Traft possessed Thalia to protect her from Emrakul 's madness

citation.work: Traft
citation.text: "Traft", section "Eldritch Moon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul's presence forces Traft out of Thalia's body.
timeline.quote: forced Traft to leave Thalia's body

citation.work: Traft
citation.text: "Traft", section "Eldritch Moon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion, Traft teams up with Rem Karolus.
timeline.quote: Saint Traft teamed up with Rem Karolus to fight the invaders

citation.work: Traft
citation.text: "Traft", section "Fighting the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Destroyed the living saint at Needle's Eye.
relations.quote: The demon Withengar had destroyed the living saint

citation.text: "The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: Angel who trusted Traft and later watches over his geist.
relations.quote: a certain angel is never far behind, always watching over him

citation.work: The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: The spirit that Traft became after death.
relations.quote: instead became a geist to haunt the world.

citation.work: The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: She carries his geist within her body as his heir.
relations.quote: communed with the geist who shared her body

pages_say.description: Young priest of the Church of Avacyn who became a saint for slaying demons; he died in a demon's trap generations ago.

citation.work: The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

pages_say.description: Living saint who fought demons alongside Avacyn's host; his ghost lingers waiting for the demons' return.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Nov 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

pages_say.description: Namesake of the Order of Saint Traft.

citation.work: Shadows over Innistrad: card flavor text
citation.text: Shadows over Innistrad: card flavor text (Shadows over Innistrad, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A holy geist and legendary saint who appears beside Thalia and is patron of her order.

citation.work: The Lunarch Inquisition
citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

pages_say.description: An ancient demon-battling saint whose geist inhabits Thalia and guides, protects and heals her.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

pages_say.description: A spirit who aided Thalia in wielding Avacyn's spear before being forced out.

citation.work: The Blessing of Blood
citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

pages_say.description: Ally of Rem during the Invasion.

citation.work: Rem Karolus
citation.text: "Rem Karolus". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: The spirit that joined with Thalia and empowered her against Eldrazi.
